lines.en: I take my lamp and check the village gate.

lines.zh: 我绕着自己住的房子转。
lines.en: I circle the house I live in.
I glance at the sign above the door.
I go to check the shelves.
I step on fallen leaves, lightly.
I pace two laps on the grass.
I come back from the trees.
I smooth my hem as I walk.
I go around the back of the house.
I walk up and stop before you.

lines.zh: 我端着灯，沿着走廊踱过去。
lines.en: Lamp in hand, I pace down the corridor.
I walk along the fence a way.
I stand at the door waiting for you.
I lean on the wall, watching the road.
I rest a hand on my hip.
I wonder what to say today.

lines.zh: 我慢慢整理了一下袖子。
lines.en: I slowly straighten my sleeve.
I stand there in a decent mood.
I watch which way the clouds go.
I wait for someone to knock.

lines.zh: 我数着院子里有几块砖。
lines.en: I count the bricks in the yard.

lines.zh: 我把货架上的东西摆了摆正。
lines.en: I straighten the goods on the shelf.
I tug the curtain.
I stand inside, looking out.
I look up at you and smile.

lines.zh: 我上下看看你，点了点头。
lines.en: I look you up and down and nod.

lines.zh: 我打量了一下你的装备。
lines.en: I size up your gear.
I wave you over.
I offer my hand.
I step aside to let you in.

lines.zh: 我在想你能帮上什么忙。
lines.en: I am wondering how you might help.
I glance behind you.
I frown, then let it pass.
I nod, as if confirming.
Have a seat and rest a while.
I ask your name slowly.
I point at the shelves inside.
There is something I would like your help with.
I step back and press the wound.
I clutch my ribs and cough twice.
I knit my brows.

lines.zh: 我喘得很急，话都说不成。
lines.en: I'm breathing so hard I can't speak.
I lean on the wall, breathing hard.
My sleeve is torn.
I slowly pick my cap up.
I stare at it and do not retreat.
I hold my arm, and it hurts.
I grit my teeth and stay on my feet.
I lift a hand and wave it off.
I do not take this one.
I glance at it, then at you.
We trade, and not in that.
I hand it back to you.
This cannot buy anything.
I smile and do not take it.

lines.zh: 我指了指货架上的价钱。
lines.en: I point at the prices on the shelf.
I shake my head, politely.
Put it away for now.
You bump me and I step aside.
I catch the doorframe to steady myself.
I do not mind; I step back smiling.
My cap goes crooked.
I straighten my cap.
We bump in the doorway, crowded.
I let you go in first.
I step over to one side.
I say sorry.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，肩膀擦过门帘。
lines.en: I turn sideways and my shoulder brushes the curtain.

lines.zh: 我们坐在同一张桌子旁。
lines.en: We sit at the same table.
She pours me a cup of water.
We talk about today's visitors.
I move my chair a little closer.
We tidy the shelves together.
She smiles and shakes her head.
Our hands touch once.
We look out at the road together.
Neither of us is in a hurry.

lines.zh: 她把灯芯挑亮，我们坐着。
lines.en: She trims the wick and we sit together.

lines.zh: 我弯腰拾起掉下的东西。
lines.en: I bend and pick up what fell.
I put it back on the shelf.

lines.zh: 我吹掉灰，把它摆回架上。
lines.en: I blow the dust off and set it back on the shelf.
I check the price.
I tuck it under the counter.
I hold it in both hands.

lines.zh: 我把它摊在柜台上给你看。
lines.en: I lay it out on the counter for you.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原位，很整齐。
lines.en: I put it back neatly.
I check the label and set it down.
I wrap it and put it away.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，放下手里的活。
lines.en: I look up and set my work down.
Someone needs help.
I take two steps toward the door.

lines.zh: 我吹灭灯，屋里一下暗了。
lines.en: I blow out the lamp and the room goes dark.
I stand blocking the doorway.
I recognize that noise.

lines.zh: 我拿起靠在墙边的家伙。
lines.en: I take up what leans against the wall.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向点了下头。
lines.en: I nod toward your direction.
This time we stand together.
I do not intend to hide.
I call out once, briefly.
I bolt the door.
I check the people inside.
I take my place beside you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步往外走。
lines.en: I follow your steps outside.
I watch from the window.
I raise the torch a little.
I am no fighter, but I can shout.
I point at the movement over there.
I keep to this doorway.
I am counting the shapes outside.

lines.zh: 我躲到门后，只露半张脸。
lines.en: I duck behind the door, half my face showing.
I check whether you are hurt.
I slowly close the door.
I have left you a way back.
I wait for it to come in.
I say something under my breath.
I grip what I am holding.
I trim the wick shorter.

lines.zh: 我抡起手边的东西砸过去。
lines.en: I swing whatever is at hand.
I shove it once.
I shoulder it away.

lines.zh: 我横过身子，替你挨这一下。
lines.en: I throw myself across to take the blow for you.
My swing is clumsy.
I strike and step back.
My arm goes numb from it.
I swing the stool and strike again.
I keep it outside the door.
I shout as I strike.
I knock over a bucket.
I retreat inside, panting.
Someone appears in front of the house.

lines.zh: 我拎着灯，从树影里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the tree shadows carrying a lamp.
The door here is open.
I stand on the grass.
I begin tidying the house.
You hear someone greet you.
I stand by the road waiting for you.
There is a sign at my door.
I lift the curtain.
I step out of the house.
I begin saying hello.

lines.zh: 这里多了一处能住人的房子。
lines.en: There is somewhere to live here now.

lines.zh: 我推开门，先探出半个身子。
lines.en: I push the door open and lean halfway out.
I slap out the fire on my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，缓了一会儿。
lines.en: I hit the ground and take a moment.
I choke and keep coughing.
I am knocked over, ears ringing.
The arrow's still in; I don't dare pull it.
That force makes my legs give.
Hunger leaves me unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整个人一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I jerk.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I fall.
